targets.rawSql: SELECT activity_hour AS time, post_mutations, like_mutations, repost_mutations, follow_mutations FROM `atmospulse_analytics.mart_network_activity_hourly` WHERE $__timeFilter(activity_hour) ORDER BY activity_hour

SELECT topic, post_count, unique_authors, engagement, velocity, acceleration, anomaly_z_score, ranking_score FROM `atmospulse_analytics.mart_topic_velocity` WHERE window_minutes = 5 AND passes_spam_guardrail AND $__timeFilter(window_start) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY window_start DESC) = 1 ORDER BY ranking_score DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT domain, shares, unique_sharers, engagement_per_share, outbound_link_share, velocity, acceleration FROM `atmospulse_analytics.mart_domain_velocity` WHERE $__timeFilter(activity_hour) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY domain ORDER BY activity_hour DESC) = 1 ORDER BY velocity DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT activity_date, actor_did, posts, engagement_received, engagement_per_post, observed_follow_edges, rolling_7d_posts FROM `atmospulse_analytics.mart_creator_growth` ORDER BY activity_date DESC, engagement_received DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT post_uri, author_did, like_count, repost_count, reply_count, quote_count, total_engagement FROM `atmospulse_analytics.mart_post_engagement` ORDER BY total_engagement DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT root_uri, reply_count, unique_participants, max_reply_depth, average_branching_factor, time_to_first_reply_seconds, observed_duration_seconds, orphan_reply_count FROM `atmospulse_analytics.mart_conversation_health` ORDER BY reply_count DESC LIMIT 100
